top_signals.title: Illegal Premier League betting could hit £1bn within year

top_signals.title: Liverpool and LA Lakers deals set new bar for sport investment
top_signals.summary: In one week Fenway Sports Group (FSG) sold 38 per cent of Liverpool to a consortium led by Amit Bhatia that also includes Jeff Bezos and Eduardo Saverin at a £5.5bn valuation, and former Disney chief Bob Iger and Donald Trump-linked Josh Kushner agreed to buy the LA Lakers for £9bn.
